with store_sales_1998 as (
  select 
    c_customer_id as customer_id,
    c_first_name as customer_first_name,
    c_last_name as customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag as customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country as customer_birth_country,
    c_login as customer_login,
    c_email_address as customer_email_address,
    d_year as dyear,
    sum(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) as year_total
  from 
    customer
    join store_sales on customer.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
    join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  where 
    d_year = 1998
  group by 
    c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
),
store_sales_1999 as (
  select 
    c_customer_id as customer_id,
    c_first_name as customer_first_name,
    c_last_name as customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag as customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country as customer_birth_country,
    c_login as customer_login,
    c_email_address as customer_email_address,
    d_year as dyear,
    sum(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) as year_total
  from 
    customer
    join store_sales on customer.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
    join date_dim on store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  where 
    d_year = 1999
  group by 
    c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
),
web_sales_1998 as (
  select 
    c_customer_id as customer_id,
    c_first_name as customer_first_name,
    c_last_name as customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag as customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country as customer_birth_country,
    c_login as customer_login,
    c_email_address as customer_email_address,
    d_year as dyear,
    sum(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) as year_total
  from 
    customer
    join web_sales on customer.c_customer_sk = web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk
    join date_dim on web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  where 
    d_year = 1998
  group by 
    c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
),
web_sales_1999 as (
  select 
    c_customer_id as customer_id,
    c_first_name as customer_first_name,
    c_last_name as customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag as customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country as customer_birth_country,
    c_login as customer_login,
    c_email_address as customer_email_address,
    d_year as dyear,
    sum(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) as year_total
  from 
    customer
    join web_sales on customer.c_customer_sk = web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk
    join date_dim on web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
  where 
    d_year = 1999
  group by 
    c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year

select 
  s1998.customer_id,
  s1998.customer_first_name,
  s1998.customer_last_name,
  s1998.customer_email_address
from 
  store_sales_1998 s1998
  join store_sales_1999 s1999 on s1998.customer_id = s1999.customer_id
  join web_sales_1998 w1998 on s1998.customer_id = w1998.customer_id
  join web_sales_1999 w1999 on s1998.customer_id = w1999.customer_id
where 
  s1998.dyear = 1998
  and s1999.dyear = 1999
  and w1998.dyear = 1998
  and w1999.d38 = 1999

      > case when s1998.year_total > 0 then s1999.year_total / s1998.year_total else 0.0 end)
order by 
  s1998.customer_id,
  s1998.customer_first_name,
  s1998.customer_last_name,
  s1998.customer_email_address
limit 100
